question: Arti and Rita can do a job in 8 hours (working together at their respective constant rates) and Arti can do the job alone in 10 hours. In how many hours can Rita do the job alone?
solution:
**Given:**

Arti and Rita can do a job together in 8 hours. 

Both of them have different constant rates)

Arti can do the job alone in 10 hours.

**Calculation:**

Arti and Rita does in one day 1/8 part of the total work

Arti alone can do in one day 1/10 part of the total work

So Rita does in one day,

(1 / 8 - 1 / 10) 

⇒ (5-4)/(40 ) = 1 / 40 part

**∴ Rita does total work alone in 40 days.**
